title: Warped shelf and defective wheels
text: Warped shelf and defective wheels. It's a solid cart and was easy enough to put together.  The wheels are smaller than I expected and not great on carpet.  Also 2 of the 4 wheels are defective and don't swivel, will have to be replaced.  The bottom shelf is warped with a noticeable bow.  For price it's ok but quality control is lacking.

product_metadata.title: Baxton Studio Lancashire Wood and Metal Kitchen Cart, Brown
features: Vintage industrial rustic design kitchen cart
Distressed wood top and shelf with ash veneer
Framed in durable rustic iron metal in bronze
Metal wheels provide the convenience of mobility
description: Stark rustic styling plus generous surface space combine in our Lancashire Wood and Metal Kitchen Cart. This triple-decker table’s vintage industrial design is achieved via antique bronze metal finishing and distressed ash veneer. Metal wheels make this kitchen cart highly mobile. Sturdy construction ensures years of use. Superior styling at a discount-furniture price.
